excerpts: [italic-ref] ...ught to cleanse him of the lust for power that drove him to commit such terrible deeds. His flavor text reads: "''He's not a medical doctor.''"  ==Notes and trivia== *He wrote the book [[Crimes Against Anatomy]]. *It is possible that the inspiration for Krastinov's character may be [[wikipedia:Josef Mengele|Josef Mengele]], head physician of the Auschwitz death camp, who used his position to carry out unspeakable acts of torture on certain inmates in the name of science, earning him the nickname 'The Angel of Death'. *His quote ''"{{text|yell|The doctor is in!}}"'' may be a reference to [[wikipedia:Hellbound: Hellraiser II|Hellraiser]]'s [[wikipedia:Dr. Channard (Hellraiser)|Dr Channard Cenobite]]. *Theolen Krastinov is voiced by [[Robin Atkin-Downes]]. *Krastinov has extensive voice over dialogue in the game files for ''[[Mists of Pandaria]]'', suggesting he was originally intended to return as a normal boss for the revamp of Scholomance. Instead, [[Krastinovian Carver]]s appear, who have apparently been surgically altered to look like Theolen Krastinov. They will sometimes randomly say lines of dialogue recorded for Krastinov while in combat. Krastinov himself does [[Doctor Theolen Krastinov|appear]] as a rare spawn in the [[Heroic]] level 90 version of Scholomance.  ==Patch changes== *{{Patch 5.0.4|note=Added.}}  ==References== {{Reflist}}  ==External links== {{Elinks-NPC|59369}}  {{DEFAULTSORT:Krastinov}} [[Category:Human charac...
